items.description: Impfondo is the capital of Likouala department in northeastern Congo. It sits near the Ubangi River and serves as a regional service center.
Owando is the administrative center of Cuvette in north-central Congo. The town sits within the Congo Basin river network and acts as a local market hub.
Gamboma is a major town in the Plateaux department of central Congo. It lies on the National Road 2 corridor and serves as a regional trade stop.
Mossendjo is a town in Niari in south-western Congo. It is a local commercial center with links to the country's road and rail corridors.
Makoua is a town in Cuvette in north-central Congo. It functions as a local administrative and trading point for the surrounding area.
Djambala is the capital of the Plateaux department in central Congo. The town sits on the plateau landscape and anchors local administration.
Mindouli is a town in Pool south of Brazzaville. It is tied to the CFCO transport corridor and serves nearby rural communities.
Mossaka is a river town in Cuvette near the Congo River floodplain. Fishing and river transport shape daily life here.
Etoumbi is a small town in Cuvette-Ouest in north-western Congo. It is best known as a rural service point in a forested area.
Sembé is a border town in Sangha in northern Congo. Its location makes it a useful stop along the route toward Cameroon.
Kellé is a town in Cuvette-Ouest in north-western Congo. It serves as a small administrative and market center for nearby villages.
Mouyondzi is a town in Bouenza in south-western Congo. It sits in an agricultural zone and supports local trade.
